Scenario: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow at 400% zoom (320px CSS viewport width)
Steps:
1. Set viewport to 320x800.
2. Measure scrollWidth vs innerWidth.
3. Assert no two-dimensional scrolling.
Expected Result: Content reflows without requiring horizontal scrolling (WCAG 1.4.10).
Actual Result: FAILED: Requires 2D scrolling. scrollWidth (421px) exceeds viewport (320px) by 101px.

Scenario: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow at 200% zoom (640px CSS viewport width)
Steps:
1. Set viewport to 640x800.
2. Measure scrollWidth vs innerWidth.
3. Assert no horizontal scrolling.
Expected Result: Page content reflows into single/two-column layout without clipping or horizontal overflow.
Actual Result: PASSED: Clean reflow at 640px width (scrollWidth: 640px, innerWidth: 640px, delta: 0px).
